invariants.description: Prompts customer with full street + area addresses before building a new cart when >1 addresses exist.
Preserves complete Flat/Building/Area/City/State in both prompt and receipt header/footer.
Decomposes dish into multiple ingredients in parallel and reconciles Subtotal + Fees == Grand Total.
Adding a follow-up item ('also add 1 amul milk 1L') merges onto existing cart items without dropping previous items.
Holds active basket intact when customer expresses hesitation instead of wiping cart or placing order.
Authorizes checkout only on explicit human confirmation ('Confirm') and generates order ID / QR state.
